# Current State of the Project

The application has already reached a strong foundation and demonstrates the qualities of a polished, modern Flutter application rather than a simple prototype. It is designed as a digital companion for Muslims, with a primary focus on daily remembrance (Adhkar), spiritual reflection, and building consistent worship habits in a peaceful and meaningful way.

The overall design follows a premium visual identity inspired by Islamic aesthetics. A carefully crafted dark green and gold color palette creates a calm, elegant atmosphere that encourages reflection and tranquility. Every screen is designed with simplicity, readability, and beauty in mind, allowing users to focus on worship without unnecessary distractions.

The home screen provides a welcoming and personalized experience. Users are greeted warmly and can immediately see their current spiritual progress through streaks, daily activity, and motivational elements. The interface is designed to feel supportive rather than demanding, encouraging users to return every day and gradually strengthen their connection with Allah.

One of the application's greatest strengths is its organization. Instead of presenting all content on a single screen, the project is structured into clear, dedicated sections that each serve a specific purpose. These include Adhkar categories, the Tasbeeh counter, statistics, user profile, settings, the Names of Allah, history, and other supporting features. Navigation is intuitive and allows users to move naturally between different parts of the application while maintaining a consistent experience.

The current architecture emphasizes scalability and maintainability. The project is built using Flutter with a clean, screen-based architecture, centralized theming, reusable components, and a persistent storage layer that manages user preferences, onboarding status, profile information, and application state. This creates a solid technical foundation that will support future expansion without requiring major structural changes.

Content organization has also been carefully considered. The application already contains structured Islamic content, making it more than a visual design. Adhkar data, supporting assets, and localization are prepared in a way that allows additional content to be added efficiently as the project grows.

Localization is one of the defining strengths of the application. While Arabic and English are already integrated, the overall experience is designed specifically with Kurdish Muslims in mind. The interface, language support, presentation, and overall identity aim to create an application that feels culturally familiar while remaining accessible to a broader audience in the future. This gives the project a unique identity instead of feeling like a generic Islamic application.

The user experience focuses on creating a peaceful spiritual environment rather than simply displaying information. Every interaction is intended to feel gentle, respectful, and meaningful. The application encourages consistency through positive reinforcement instead of pressure, allowing users to build lasting spiritual habits at their own pace.

Visually, the project already demonstrates a high level of polish. Consistent spacing, elegant typography, thoughtful color choices, modern icons, and smooth navigation combine to create an interface that feels refined and trustworthy. The current design communicates quality while remaining simple enough for users of all ages.

Overall, the project has successfully established a clear vision. It already functions as much more than a traditional Adhkar application; it is evolving into a comprehensive spiritual companion that helps Muslims engage in remembrance, reflection, and daily worship through a beautiful, accessible, and culturally meaningful digital experience. The existing foundation is strong, well organized, scalable, and ready to support the many advanced features planned for future versions while preserving the application's core mission of helping users strengthen their relationship with Allah through consistent daily remembrance.
# imanikurd-quran

Quran database, 13 Kurdish Tafsirs, and audio recitations logic for the Kurdish community. Part of the `imanikurd` toolkit.

## Installation

```bash
npm install imanikurd-quran
```

## Features

- **Full Quran Text**: All 6236 ayahs with Kurdish and Arabic metadata.
- **13 Kurdish Tafsirs**: Includes Tafsir Rebar, Asan, Raman, Hazhar, and more.
- **Audio Recitations**: Reciters (Qaris) and audio link generators.

## Usage

```typescript
import { getSurah, getSurahAyahs, getTafsirForAyah } from "imanikurd-quran";

// Get Surah Al-Fatiha
const surah = getSurah(1);
console.log(surah.englishName); // Al-Fatiha

// Get Tafsir for Al-Fatiha Ayah 1
const tafsir = getTafsirForAyah(1, 1, "rebar");
console.log(tafsir); // Kurdish Tafsir text
```
